summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and widens ControlCode with Tuple[ControlType, str]; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 format entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and the Control.title classmethod; rich/console.py adds set_window_title, gated only on is_terminal and returning a bool; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds a SET_WINDOW_TITLE branch that calls term.set_title; CHANGELOG.md gets an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200; tests were added to test_console.py, test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py. No tests were run and nothing was committed, per instructions, so verification is by reading only.
